meta.method: Monthly Retail BDT, four named commodities; exclude Division pseudo-markets; exact KG/L units. Keep actual and aggregate flags, no invented observations. Missing months stay missing. Seven lag/season features; target next-month price / last-month price. Fixed chronological train/6-month validation/12-month test per commodity. Select by validation MAE only; fit once before test; rolling test uses preceding observed lags. Refit on all data for next-month snapshot forecasts. Historical snapshot may include revisions; this is not vintage-safe operational backtesting. Markets share one commodity model; MAE is pooled, not guaranteed per market.
